schoolName: Solomon Islands National University — Faculty of Nursing, Medicine and Health Sciences
reviewNotes: HOLD — SINU's current faculty page confirms the Faculty of Nursing, Medicine and Health Sciences and names Schools of Nursing, Public Health and Medicine. The university's 2026 admissions notice and fee links confirm an active general admissions cycle. However, current programme evidence on the faculty page documents nursing and postgraduate health leadership, while the WHED programme summary lists Nursing, Midwifery and Public Health—not a medical degree. No current Doctor of Medicine/MBBS programme title, curriculum, fees, admissions, clinical pathway, recognition or international route could be confirmed. The faculty label must not be treated as proof that an undergraduate medical degree is offered.
